ambient: The machine changes note, holds it, and settles back.
Somewhere in the pipework a valve is turned by somebody thorough.
The chair creaks, the way a chair does when someone gets up.
description: A room under a building, full of pipework and one enormous machine that is running well. It has been maintained by somebody who cared. There is a chair by it, and a mug, and a logbook, and whoever kept this place stepped out for a moment that has lasted a very long time.
name: Plant Room

looks: Entries every day in the same hand, going back further than the building.
The last entry is today, and it is in your handwriting.
Every entry says the same thing: STILL RUNNING. NOTHING TO REPORT.
objects.name: the logbook

looks: Running sweetly. You have no idea what it does and you are certain it matters.
Warm, and slightly damp, and breathing.
There is a panel you could open. You will not.
objects.name: the machine

looks: Still hot. Tea, with the bag left in.
It has your name on it, spelled the way it sounds.
Empty, and rinsed, and put back wrong.
objects.name: the mug

weather: It is very warm and slightly damp, and the warmth is coming from something that is working.
